Commission Agreement Between 613PAINTING and

Date: September 10, 2025
Parties
This agreement is entered into between 613PAINTING (represented by Katrina O’Neill) and Ottawa
Painters (represented by Jad & Moe), effective September 9, 2025 through October 10, 2025.
1. Commission Structure
For the duration of this agreement, any contracts booked by Katrina O’Neill on behalf of Ottawa
Painters will be subject to a 10% commission payable to Katrina. Commission will be calculated based
on the total contract value (before tax).
2. Payment Terms
Payments may be made via e-transfer to katoneill613@gmail.com. Ottawa Painters may choose to pay
either: - Upon closing of each contract, or - Weekly totals for all contracts closed that week. Example
Commission Calculation: - Contract Value (before tax): $5,000 - HST (13%): $650 - Total Client Invoice
(incl. HST): $5,650 - 10% Commission (before tax): $500 In this example, the client pays $5,650 to
Ottawa Painters, and Katrina receives $500 as her commission.
3. Goals in 30 Days
Katrina’s goal for the trial period (September 9 – October 10, 2025) is to: - Successfully close 2 out of 3
qualified estimates, and - Book an average of $5,000 + HST per week or more in contract value for
Ottawa Painters.
4. Jad & Moe Goals
Ottawa Painters (Jad & Moe) will enter their goals for the term of this contract below:
________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________
5. Quality Standards
Ottawa Painters agree to produce a high-level quality job on all projects, including: - Clear and
professional communication with the client, - Nice, straight cut lines, - Full and even coverage, -
Excellent clean-up for a top-tier professional painting job. If these standards are not met and
performance reflects poorly on either company, quality issues will need to be addressed immediately
and the terms of this agreement may be renegotiated.
6. Trial Period Review
After October 10, 2025, Ottawa Painters will review the performance of this agreement to ensure: -
Quotes are accurate, - The payment model is sustainable, - Company revenues are trending in the right
direction. At the end of the trial, both parties may reassess and renegotiate the terms.

7. Roles and Responsibilities
Katrina (613PAINTING) will: - Qualify all incoming leads, - Conduct site visits, - Provide color
consultations, - Send detailed quote options, - Provide job production notes. Jad & Moe (Ottawa
Painters) will: - Update DripJobs, - Send proposals directly to clients. Production Manager (Ottawa
Painters) will: - Take over once a job is booked, - Execute on-site production, - Handle client
communication from that point forward. Note: Katrina will no longer be directly involved with the client
after booking but will remain available for questions from Jad and Moe if needed.
8. Termination Clause
Either party may terminate this agreement at any time with proper written notice, in cases including but
not limited to: - Poor performance, - Misconduct, - Breach of responsibilities.
9. Reassessment
Following the trial period, both parties agree to meet, review results, and renegotiate the terms if
mutually beneficial.
